props.name: activationMode
props.description:
The activation mode for the preview element.

- "focus" - Enter edit mode when the preview is focused
- "dblclick" - Enter edit mode when the preview is double-clicked
- "click" - Enter edit mode when the preview is clicked
- "none" - Edit can be triggered programmatically only

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Whether the editable should auto-resize to fit the content.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: defaultEdit
props.description: Whether the editable is in edit mode by default.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the editable when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the editable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the editable is disabled.

props.name: edit
props.description: Whether the editable is in edit mode.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: The element to receive focus when the editable is closed.

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the editable. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the input's value is invalid.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in the editable

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute of the editable component. Used for form submission.

props.name: onEditChange
props.description: Function to call when the edit mode changes.

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function to call when the value changes.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Function to call when the value is committed.

props.name: onValueRevert
props.description: Function to call when the value is reverted.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text for the editable.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the editable is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the editable is required.

props.name: selectOnFocus
props.description: Whether to select the text in the input when it is focused.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the rendered element.

props.name: submitMode
props.description:
The action that triggers submit in the edit mode:

- "enter" - Trigger submit when the enter key is pressed
- "blur" - Trigger submit when the editable is blurred
- "none" - No action will trigger submit. You need to use the submit button
- "both" - Pressing `Enter` and blurring the input will trigger submit

props.name: translations
props.description: The translations for the editable.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the editable.
